title: The Pieri box-shift as a non-commutative Fourier single-step shift
html: Remark (spectral shift). Under the non-commutative Fourier transform, the degree-one element acts as a discrete finite-difference operator. It shifts the Young-diagram support up or down by exactly one box, analogous to a single-step translation on the commutative frequency lattice.
